paths.description: Homepage and recommendation feed, representing discovery and browsing.
Popular listing, representing a dense ranked content index.
Video detail and playback, the primary content-consumption journey.
Search results for “AI”, representing query, filtering, ads and pagination.
Account login, representing authentication and input assistance.
Deliberately invalid route, representing HTTP/navigation recovery.

findings.summary: Dark preference is ignored
findings.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the probe reports color-scheme: normal, body background rgb(241,242,243), dark media matched, and no theme media rules; the dark screenshot remains light.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and theme surfaces using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Low-contrast controls are not adapted
findings.evidence: The high-contrast screenshot is visually unchanged, no prefers-contrast/forced-colors rules were found, and Lighthouse measured 2.75:1 on pink primary controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast handling, preserving system colors and visible control boundaries.

findings.summary: State changes use abrupt swaps
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across homepage, listing, search and detail found no view-transition declarations or API use despite route, carousel and disclosure state changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance meaningful route and state changes with View Transitions, respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not react to scroll state
findings.evidence: Homepage and listing inspection found fixed/static navigation but no scroll-state container query, progress marker, or scroll-position feedback on long feeds.
findings.suggestedFix: Add proportionate scroll-state feedback such as a shrinking sticky header or progress affordance without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Large custom popovers lack semantic anchored positioning
findings.evidence: The load-time login overlay is a role-less .v-popover absolutely positioned at 361×256; no native popover or CSS anchor declarations were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover with CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks, plus an accessible trigger relationship.

findings.summary: Login promotion obscures content on load
findings.evidence: The initial homepage screenshot shows a 361×256 login promotion covering the first viewport before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not open account promotion on load; keep login available in navigation and show dismissible prompts only after relevant intent.

findings.summary: Overlays are ad-hoc divs
findings.evidence: The visible .v-popover has no role; platform probe found 0 dialog, 0 [popover], and 0 details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace custom overlay containers with popover/dialog/details as appropriate and use declarative light dismiss.

findings.summary: Dense chrome competes with content
findings.evidence: The homepage first viewport combines a full-width animated banner, two navigation rows, many category pills and an unsolicited login panel before the recommendation grid.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary categories, remove the unsolicited panel, and reserve the first viewport for search and primary content.

findings.summary: Desktop layout is scaled down on mobile
findings.evidence: At 360×800 the page has no viewport meta and Chrome lays it out at 1105 CSS px then scales it to 0.326; controls and text become tiny rather than reflowing.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standard viewport meta tag and implement intrinsic mobile reflow without fixed desktop minimum widths.

findings.summary: Reusable cards do not adapt at component level
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection of home, popular and search card grids found no @container rules; the mobile capture retains the desktop card density.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable grids/cards containment and size-aware container queries, with fluid intrinsic fallbacks.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch targets are inadequate
findings.evidence: Focus probing found links and inputs with outline none, two unlabeled 28×28 buttons, and many 24–28 px targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore strong :focus-visible indicators and enlarge compact controls to at least a comfortable 44 CSS px target or equivalent spacing.

findings.summary: Mobile loading is slow
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 17.6 s, FCP 3.5 s, TBT 350 ms and performance 0.55; trace corroborated four long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset, reduce redirects and critical work, and break up startup JavaScript.

findings.summary: Mobile feed shifts substantially
findings.evidence: The 360×800 layout observer recorded CLS 0.240, including shifts of 0.165 and 0.076 after about 5–6 seconds.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve stable space for late feed/banner content and give media explicit dimensions/aspect-ratio.

findings.summary: Startup scripting blocks the main thread
findings.evidence: Trace recorded 4 long tasks, longest 94 ms and TBT 106 ms; Lighthouse measured 2.0 s main-thread work and 350 ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Split startup work, schedule non-critical tasks by priority, and defer analytics and below-fold hydration.

findings.summary: Critical delivery has long blocking chains
findings.evidence: HAR found parser-blocking scripts without async/defer and Lighthouse estimated 1.37 s savings from render-blocking requests; 158 requests transferred 2.38 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical parser scripts, inline only critical CSS, preload only the true LCP resource, and improve cache lifetimes.

findings.summary: Large unused client bundles ship on first load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 303 KiB unused JS, 72 KiB unused CSS and 219 KiB unminified JS; HAR transferred 731 KiB of scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by route, remove legacy/duplicate bundles for modern clients, minify production assets, and load optional features on demand.

findings.summary: Interactive controls lack accessible names and structure
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed link-name; probing found two unlabeled buttons, image-heavy links with empty text, and 36 images without alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control/link an accessible name, label inputs, and provide meaningful alt while keeping decorative images empty.

findings.summary: Primary controls fail text contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured only 2.75:1 for white text on #ff6699 Download/Open App controls, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the pink surface or use dark foreground text to meet WCAG contrast in every state.

findings.summary: Heading/landmark and focus structure is weak
findings.evidence: Homepage probe found no h1/h2, only h3 cards and a single main landmark; Lighthouse mobile found no main landmark, and all sampled focus outlines were none.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a logical h1→h2→h3 hierarchy, consistent landmarks, and visible focus styles in DOM order.

findings.summary: Zoom, reflow and media alternatives are restricted
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found user-scalable=no/maximum-scale=1 on the mobile variant; the tested video had zero text tracks and many controls were 28 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow pinch zoom, reflow at narrow widths, enlarge targets, and provide caption tracks/transcripts for video.

findings.summary: Image sizing is inconsistent
findings.evidence: Images audit found 26/58 missing dimensions, 39 oversized, 53 without srcset and 36 missing alt, despite a valid doctype and UTF-8 charset.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio and responsive srcset/sizes, while retaining valid document metadata.

findings.summary: Deprecated and legacy platform code remains
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported deprecated StorageType.persistent usage and 37 KiB legacy JavaScript savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace deprecated persistent storage APIs with navigator.storage and modernize delivery while preserving Baseline fallbacks.

findings.summary: Homepage is not mobile-friendly
findings.evidence: The desktop homepage has no viewport meta; its mobile rendering is scaled from an 1105 px layout. Links are crawlable and robots permits the page, but the mobile requirement fails.
findings.suggestedFix: Add viewport metadata and responsive reflow while retaining real href links and descriptive text.

findings.summary: Transport defenses and cookie flags are missing
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but headers probe found no CSP, HSTS or nosniff; all 13 cookies lacked Secure and used SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, a restrictive CSP, nosniff, and Secure/SameSite cookie attributes; make sensitive cookies HttpOnly.

findings.summary: Large tracking and third-party footprint loads by default
findings.evidence: HAR classified 154/158 requests and 2.12 MB as cross-origin, including data.bilibili.com and cm.bilibili.com; tracker probe saw 10 cross-origin hosts.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize default telemetry, batch necessary events, and defer non-essential measurement until consent or clear need.

findings.summary: Authentication offers no passkey path
findings.evidence: Login probe exposed password, SMS, QR and social paths but no navigator.credentials use or passkey option. No permission prompt appeared on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration/authentication as a phishing-resistant option and retain contextual fallback methods.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced policies are absent
findings.evidence: Headers probe found no HSTS, clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy, and no CSP/frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS, frame-ancestors (or X-Frame-Options fallback), strict referrer policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Core homepage content disappears without JavaScript
findings.evidence: Discoverability fetch found 0% rendered-word coverage in 1,374 bytes of raw HTML; title and description were absent from raw markup.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core navigation and feed content, then hydrate enhancements so no-JS users and crawlers retain the primary experience.

findings.summary: Custom overlay is fragile at constrained viewports
findings.evidence: The custom absolute login popover has no anchor fallback and the mobile page is a scaled desktop canvas, increasing clipping and positioning risk.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native popover plus CSS anchor fallback positions and test edge placement at narrow/zoomed conditions.

findings.summary: App-like media experience has no install/offline layer
findings.evidence: Platform probe found no manifest and no service-worker registration for this app-like video service.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a web app manifest and a small offline fallback for navigation/history; keep streaming features explicitly online-only.

findings.summary: Language metadata is inconsistent across account flow
findings.evidence: Homepage declares lang=zh-CN, but the login document has empty lang and dir; no logical-property evidence was found in inspected login/home styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang and dir on every document and prefer inline/block logical properties for translation-ready layouts.

findings.summary: Published timestamps are timezone-ambiguous
findings.evidence: Video detail renders “2026-07-16 10:20:00” without a timezone or semantic time element, so global interpretation is ambiguous.
findings.suggestedFix: Store instants unambiguously and render localized time with an explicit zone/offset and semantic datetime.

findings.summary: Empty login submit gives no actionable validation
findings.evidence: After an empty login submit, inputs had no required or aria-invalid state and no field-specific error appeared; focus remained on body.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction, focus the first invalid field, set aria-invalid, and announce concise recovery text.

findings.summary: Sign-in autofill tokens are generic
findings.evidence: Account and password inputs report autocomplete="on" rather than username/current-password and have no associated labels in a semantic form.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real form, persistent labels, and autocomplete=username/current-password (plus one-time-code for SMS).

findings.summary: Account flow lacks phishing-resistant authentication
findings.evidence: The account page exposes password/SMS/QR/social options but no passkey authentication or reauthentication path.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys and clear recovery/reauthentication, while preserving visible terms and alternative methods.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes
findings.evidence: Images probe found 39 oversized images, 53 without srcset, 26 without dimensions and only 32/58 in a detected modern format.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive AVIF/WebP variants with srcset/sizes and correctly prioritize only the LCP image.

findings.summary: Initial load performs disproportionate background work
findings.evidence: The page issued 68 XHR/fetches and 158 requests total, with analytics/reporting hosts active before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer and batch background telemetry, eliminate redundant fetches, and suspend non-essential work offscreen/backgrounded.

findings.summary: Third-party and media budget is heavy
findings.evidence: 2.38 MB transferred on load, including 1.16 MB images; 2.12 MB was cross-origin and the video begins playback muted on its detail page.
findings.suggestedFix: Budget third-party/media bytes, lazy-load nonessential assets, and avoid starting media before explicit user intent.

findings.summary: Repeated feed traversal grows retained heap sharply
findings.evidence: After 10 bottom/top feed traversals, heap summary grew from 376,116 nodes/23.7 MB to 736,095 nodes/38.8 MB, with closures 26,285→64,282. Lazy feed retention may explain part, so confidence is medium.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound feed caches, virtualize offscreen cards, release observers/listeners, and verify with same-session baseline/target/final snapshots.

taskList.title: Build a responsive, zoomable and keyboard-visible shell
Reduce critical load work and stabilize late content
Deploy security headers and safe cookie policy
Server-render core content for no-JS resilience
Repair names, landmarks, headings, contrast and captions
Remove unsolicited login overlay and adopt native anchored popovers
Optimize responsive media and telemetry budgets
Modernize account forms with validation, autofill and passkeys
